scope: Raw pools before ranking/refinement; reused pools are not independent repeats

reward_signal.definition: Population reward variance within each rollout group; summed between evaluable/ineligible and within-category components
reward_signal.interpretation: Descriptive reward contrast, not a causal decomposition of policy gradients
